decision.reason: The only evidence, [ev-35cf1ed1a407], is a one-line changelog title. It names the subject (the OIDC 'sub' claim when Dex is used) and the change (the claim is overridden with federated_claims.user_id). It does not say how a deployment counts as 'using Dex', so applicability cannot be written as a checkable condition. It also gives no consequence: it does not say whether existing sub-based RBAC policies, user identities or tokens behave differently after the upgrade, or whether this only fixes broken behaviour. We need the PR (#20683) description or an upgrade-guide entry that states the before/after value of 'sub' and what changes for exposed environments.
